kurzbeschreibung: The Wallfahrtskirche Kaltenbrunn in the Kaunertal is among the oldest Marian pilgrimage sites in Tirol and is regarded as a sanctuary of peace and contemplation.
beschreibung:
Centuries-Old Pilgrimage Tradition in the Kaunertal

At the entrance to the picturesque high valley stands the Wallfahrtskirche Kaltenbrunn. The origins of the pilgrimage date back to 1272 when, according to legend, a returning knight dedicated a statue of the Virgin Mary at a healing mountain spring.

Late Gothic Architecture and Baroque Splendor

Today, the church presents itself as an elaborately furnished house of worship featuring a Late Gothic core structure and magnificent Baroque altars. To this day, pilgrims and hikers journey to this peaceful place of strength at the foot of the steep Kaunertal mountain giants.
